Quotes

Pieces of wisdom I try to live by

  • The best revenge is to not be like your enemy - Marcus Aurelius
  • You don’t have to be the best to do your best - Bear Grylls
  • Fast success builds ego but slow success builds character - Unknown
  • Anger is just as much a sign of weakness as suffering is, because both an angry man and a man in pain have surrendered to a wound they’ve incurred - Marcus Aurelius
  • To become who you want to be, you must sacrifice who you are - Miyamoto Musashi
  • Nothing is for certain until it has happened - Mark Manson
  • Life’s too short to be angry - Tabitha McKinney
  • Don’t wait to be brought flowers, plant your own garden - Jimmy Carr
  • Great men do not take, they give - Unknown
  • From a certain point onward there is no longer any turning back. That is the point that must be reached - Franz Kafka
  • Being poor is hard, getting rich is hard. Being overweight is hard, getting fit is hard. Being married is hard, being single is hard. Every single choice in life is hard. Choose your hard. Or hard will choose you instead - Unknown
  • Only those who take risks deserve to experience the extraordinary - Unknown
  • I have no special talent. I am only passionately curious - Albert Einstein
  • The only man who never makes a mistake is the man who never does anything - Theodore Roosevelt
  • When you go through hell, don’t stop, because why would you stop in hell? - Steve Harvey
  • Every day I wake up I say to myself “you have 2 options right now, keep dreaming your dreams or wake up and make it reality. I choose the 2nd option always - Ilia Topuria
  • Intelligence is not what you know, it’s what you do when you don’t know - Jean Piaget
  • If it matters to you, you will make time - Nick Bare
  • The chains of habit are too weak to be felt until they are too strong to be broken - Samuel Johnson
  • What you most want is what you most can’t have, and what you most can’t have is what you already had, and lost - Odysseus
  • The only way out is through - Unknown
  • The blood of the covenant is thicker than the water of the womb - Unknown
  • Greatness is built when nobody is watching - Unknown
  • Once you are ready to fail you are ready to succeed - Unknown
  • Consistently good is better than occassionally great - Jeff Cunningham
  • Genetics deals the cards, environment plays the hand - Bill Beswick
  • There’s a thousand excuses but not a single reason - Bill Beswick
  • If you’re not exhausted by the end of the day, what are you reserving that energy for? - Nick Bare
  • The more you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you’ll go - Dr. Seuss
  • Belief comes before ability - Nick Bare
  • You don’t rise to the level of your goals, you fall to the level of your systems - James Clear
  • Adversity introduces you to you - Albert Einstein
  • The meaning of life is to give life meaning - Viktor E. Frankl
  • I know of no better life purpose than to perish attempting the great and impossible. The fact that something seems impossible should not be a reason to pursue it. That’s exactly what makes it worth pursuing. Where would the courage and greatness be if success was certain and there was no risk. The only true failure is shrinking away from life’s challenges. - Frederick Nietzche
  • Whoever makes a beast of himself gets rid of the pain of being a man - Samuel Johnson
  • By focusing on the process, the outcome becomes inevitable - Ross Edgely
  • Struggle alone is enough to fill a man’s heart - Albert Camus
  • Money makes you more of what you already are - Unknown
  • We can afford to lose money, even a lot of money, but we can’t afford to lose reputation, even a shred of reputation - Warren Buffet
  • The flame that burns twice as bright burns half as long - Lao Tzu
  • I learned 30 years ago that it is foolish to scold. I have enough trouble overcoming my own limitations without fretting over the fact that God has not seen fit to distribute evenly the gift of intelligence - John Wanamaker
  • Icarus laughed as he fell, for he knew that falling meant that he had soared - Fiona
  • I shall pass this way but once; any good, therefore, that I can do or any kindness that I can show to any human being, let me do it now. Let me not defer nor neglect it, for I shall not pass this way again - Etienne de Grellet
